events.title: Grounded spec built
events.reasoning: The catalog and PRD confirm that Procol’s sourcing events can be created, vendors invited, and awards granted, with team‑based user management. Both the code and config map show the backend validates the phone field only for length, while the PRD requires any 10‑digit number. This mismatch means the system could accept non‑numeric strings like “ABCDEFGHIJ,” violating the specification. Testing should focus on submitting various 10‑character strings (numeric and non‑numeric) to verify that only true digits are accepted.

deltas.prdSays: Accept any 10-digit number; reject malformed input politely (PRD §4.3, §5).
deltas.productDoes: The API checks phone LENGTH (rejects 9 or 11 digits) but NOT that characters are digits — it accepts a 10-char value containing letters. The frontend enforces digits-only, so the API is more lenient than the UI.

events.title: 6 cases (LLM (Groq, RAG-grounded))
events.reasoning: I designed 6 detailed test case(s) this pass (LLM (Groq, RAG-grounded)) covering functional, data-validation, edge for 2 flow(s). Each has preconditions, numbered steps, positive/negative test data, and a precise expected result. Total so far: 6 cases across 3 dimension(s).

cases.scenario: Create RFQ event, place surrogate bid and open award proposal
cases.preconditions: Buyer is logged in, at least one vendor is active in the system, trade:create_record config switch is ON.
steps: 4. POST /v1/trade/add_audience?id=trade-01 to invite vendor-5678 to the RFQ stage
5. Using the UI, create a surrogate bid on behalf of vendor-5678 for the RFQ stage (price 12.50 per EA, total 1250.00)
6. Click "Open award proposal" for the RFQ stage.
cases.testData: Positive: title='Office Supplies RFQ', product_uuid='prod-1234', quantity.value=100, vendor id='vendor-5678', price=12.50.
cases.expectedResult: Event status becomes 'active', RFQ stage (stage_no=1, rfx_mode='rfq') is persisted, audience link to vendor-5678 is stored, surrogate bid record exists with price 12.50, award proposal is created with status 'proposed'. DB verification confirms trade record with award_status='proposed' and surrogate_flag=true.

cases.scenario: Create a 2‑stage RFP then RFQ event and verify both stages in DB
cases.preconditions: Buyer is logged in, trade:create_record config switch is ON.
steps: 5. POST /v1/trade/add_audience?id=trade-02 to invite vendor-1111 and vendor-2222 to both stages.
cases.testData: Positive: title='IT Services Procurement', product_uuid='svc-9876', quantity.value=200, vendors='vendor-1111','vendor-2222'.
cases.expectedResult: Two trade records are created: stage 1 with rfx_mode='rfp' and stage 2 with rfx_mode='rfq'. Both records are persisted in the database and linked to the event UUID. Audience entries for both vendors are stored for each stage. No errors returned.

cases.scenario: Missing mandatory field 'title' when creating event group
cases.expectedResult: API returns HTTP 400 with error message "title is required". No event group is created in the database.

cases.scenario: Negative quantity value in line item
cases.expectedResult: API returns HTTP 422 with error message "quantity.value must be a positive integer". Event group is not persisted.

cases.scenario: Attempt to open award proposal after bid window has closed
cases.preconditions: RFQ event is active, bid_end_time set to a past timestamp (e.g., 2026-08-01T17:00:00Z). Surrogate bid has already been recorded.
steps: 1. Click "Open award proposal" for the RFQ stage after the bid_end_time has passed.
cases.expectedResult: System displays error "Bid window closed; cannot award" and does not create an award proposal. No change in DB for award_status.

cases.scenario: Create event with title exceeding maximum length
cases.preconditions: Buyer is logged in. System maximum title length is 255 characters.
cases.expectedResult: API returns HTTP 400 with error message "title exceeds maximum length of 255 characters". Event group is not created.
